δῶρα: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom. pl. · also neut. acc. pl., object of διδοῖς: ’gifts’

περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πηλέος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
πηλεὺς: Πηλεύς — Peleus, king of the Myrmidons, father of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
πηλῆϊ: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. dat. sg., epic Πηλῆϊ (= Attic Πηλεῖ): ’to Peleus’
πλῆτο: πελάζω — bring near; mid./pass. draw near, come to; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented: ’was brought to’ (+ dat.) · also πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic: ’was filled’ (+ gen.)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’ · also πρίν … ὅτε, ’until the time when’ · also πρίν γε … ἠέ after a negative, ’until’
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρύμνῃσιν: πρύμνη — stern of a ship; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’sterns’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., with πύλαι · also fem. nom. pl. with another fem. noun: ’all’ (πᾶσαι χολάδες ’all the bowels’) · also fem. nom. pl., in apposition to a pronoun: ’all (of them)’ (αἳ … πᾶσαι ’they all’) · also fem. nom. pl. agreeing with feminine town-names: ’all (the towns)’
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σιδήρῳ: σίδηρος — iron; masc. dat. sg., also an iron tool or weapon
σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
στήθεα: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic στήθη)
στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, ruthless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg., of a person or god
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τέκον: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτεκον): ’I bore’
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., in apposition: ’young, offspring’ (τέκος ἐλάφοιο ’the young of a deer’)

τανυσθεὶς: τανύω — stretch, stretch out; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’stretched out’
ταχὺν: ταχύς — swift, quick; adj., masc. acc. sg.
ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg.
ταὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they, those two’
ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τυπεὶς: τύπτω — strike; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’struck, wounded’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῖον: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔτῑον): ’honoured’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)

υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φίλῃσι: φίλος — dear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φίλαις), agreeing with a feminine plural noun
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρονέοντ: φρονέω — think, ponder; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (φρονέοντ’ = φρονέοντα), epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντα)
φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
χέουσα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’pouring, shedding’
χέων: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’shedding (tears)’
χαρίεν: χαρίεις — graceful, charming; neut. nom./acc. sg.
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χραισμῆσαι: χραισμέω — ward off, avail, help (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.: ’to ward off’
ἀγαυοῦ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Τυδέος · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Λαομέδοντος: ’noble (Laomedon)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Πηλεΐωνος: ’noble (son of Peleus)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Τιθωνοῖο: ’noble (Tithonus)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἰδομενῆος: ’noble (Idomeneus)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἰλιονῆος: ’noble (Ilioneus)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Τελαμῶνος: ’noble (Telamon)’
ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.

ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀκούουσαι: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl., + acc.: ’hearing’
ἀκτὴν: ἀκτή — grain, ground corn (Δημήτερος ἀκτή ’Demeter’s grain’); fem. acc. sg.
ἀλήμεναι: εἴλω — press, pack together; aor. 2 pass. inf., epic athematic -μεναι (= Attic ἁλῆναι): ’to be packed together, to crowd together’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard, cultivated plot; fem. gen. sg.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’) · also adv. and preverb in tmesis, elided: ’round about’ (ἀμφ’ … ἀΰτευν ’rang round about’) · also + gen., ’about, over’ (ἀμφ’ ὀλίγης πίδακος ’about a small spring’)
ἀμφιμάχονται: ἀμφιμάχομαι — fight around; pres. 3 pl. mid./dep., + acc.
ἀμύμονά: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent; adj., masc. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
ἀνέδραμεν: ἀνατρέχω — run up; strong aor. 3 sg. (stem δραμ-), ν-movable: ’ran up’
ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
ἀνασχὼν: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
ἀντίλοχος: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.

ἀπέδυσε: ἀποδύω — strip off; strip a dead man of his arms; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’stripped’
ἀποτίσῃ: ἀποτίνω — pay back, atone for; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’he may pay for’

ἀτυζόμενοι: ἀτύζομαι — be bewildered, panic; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’in panic’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also ἅλς (masc.) — salt; masc. gen. sg., partitive: ’of salt’
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. acc. pl.: ’his own’ (τὰ ἃ φρονέων ’thinking his own thoughts’)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄκοιτιν: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
ἄκουσε: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσε)
ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.
ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
ἄνωγε: ἄνωγα — command, bid, order; perf. with pres./past force, 3 sg.: ’bids, bade’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’the best (thing)’ (ὃ … ἄριστον … εἴη ’that would be the best’)

ἄχνυται: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, be distressed; pres. 3 sg. mid./dep.: ’grieves’
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’

ἐκάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, veil, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented
ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, bid, order; impf. 3 pl.
ἐμή: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. voc. sg. (= nom. in form), agreeing with μῆτερ: ’my (mother)’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμῇ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. sg.
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with κάρητι: ’my own’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’my’

ἐπιπροέηκα: ἐπιπροΐημι — send forth to; aor. 1 sg. act., epic -έηκα (= Attic ἐπιπροῆκα): ’I sent forth’
ἐπισχερώ: ἐπισχερώ — in a row, one after another, in succession; adv. (from σχερός ’continuous line’)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρίβωλον: ἐρίβωλος — rich-soiled, fertile; fem. acc. sg.
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑοῖο: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔμβαλον: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, cast on; aor. 3 pl. act. (ἐν + βάλλω): ’threw in’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — standing out, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος, + gen. of comparison: ’choice beyond (others)’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial, + gen. of comparison: ’above (others)’ (ἔξοχον ἄλλων)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔσσεαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg., epic ἔσσεαι (= Attic ἔσῃ): ’you will be’
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
ἡμένη: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦδος: ἦδος — pleasure, delight; neut. nom. sg.
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’ · also aor. mid. inf., after πάρος: ’before seeing’ · also aor. mid. inf. after μένε, expressing what is awaited: ’to see’ (μένε … ἰδέσθαι ’was waiting to see’) · also aor. mid. inf. after δός, expressing what is granted: ’to see’ (δὸς … ἰδέσθαι ’grant to see’)
ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἴαχον: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’they shouted’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’ · also masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’equal (to)’ (ὃν ἶσον ἐτίομεν ’whom we honoured as equal’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’equal’ (ἶσον θυμὸν ἔχοντες ’with an equal spirit’)
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀλέσσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσῃ): ’he may lose’
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀρθοκραιράων: ὀρθόκραιρα — straight-horned; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with βοῶν
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁρᾷ: ὁράω — see; pres. subj. 3 sg. (the indic. has the same spelling), with ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν: ’as long as he sees’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄφελες: ὀφείλω — owe, ought; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (ὄφελες = ὤφελες) with an inf. in a wish: ’would that you had’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’) · also temporal, ’until’ + aor. subj., without ἄν (ὄφρ’ ἀνέληται ’until she takes (him) up’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … ὤσαιτο ’so that he might drive back’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
ὅσαι: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οὐδέ τι ᾔδη ὅττι … ’nor did he know that …’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that, because’, giving the cause of anger (χώσατο … ὅττι ’was incensed that’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of rejoicing, accented before the enclitic οἱ (γήθησέν τε ὅττί … ’rejoiced that …’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’)
ὠκύμορος: ὠκύμορος — swift to one’s doom, short-lived (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. sg.
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὤλεθ: ὄλλυμι (mid. ὄλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλεθ’ = ὤλετο): ’he perished’
ὤφελλε: ὀφείλω (epic ὀφέλλω) — owe; ought; impf. 3 sg., of what ought not to have been: ’ought’
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ᾤμωξεν: οἰμώζω — cry out in pain, wail; aor. 3 sg. act.
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
